notes.subject: תערג
notes.rationale: Rare verb, 'pant/gasplong for'; Bambara ɲini (seek) captures the longing, loses the physical gasping.

notes.subject: תערג ... תערג
notes.rationale: The verb repeats in both halves of the simile — deer and soul seek alike.

notes.subject: nin
notes.rationale: נפש is throat/breath/life-force, not immaterial 'soul'; Bambara nin (life-breath) keeps the concrete sense.

notes.subject: Yawe
notes.rationale: The psalm's singer addresses Elohim directly; the vocative Name added once for clarity per D1 discipline — {Yawe}.

translation: I n'a fɔ sɛgɛsɛgɛbagan min bɛ ji kɔnɔna ɲini, nin nin in de bɛ Ala, i Yawe ɲini.
